finding.headline: "The Childless-Friends Gap"
finding.problem: "They post brunch photos without me. I'm scared if I bring the baby they'll be bored, but if I don't show up I lose them. I miss my friends so much it hurts."
finding.person: 30-yr-old professional Nigerian/British mum whose child-free friends stopped inviting her; she feels she must choose between her baby and her oldest friendships.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Bring the Baby: Keeping Child-Free Friends Without Losing Yourself."". Verdict: PASSES.
